## free-tier-llm-landscape
1. Groq has increased their free tier limit from 100MB to 500MB, but they now limit the number of API calls to 1000 per day.
2. Together has increased their free tier limit for large models from 10MB to 50MB, but now have a new limit of 1000 API calls per day.
3. OpenRouter has increased their free tier limit for large models from 10MB to 50MB, but now have a limit of 500 API calls per day.
4. Google Gemini has increased their free tier limit for large models from 10MB to 50MB, but now have a limit of 1000 API calls per day.
5. Hugging Face has not changed their free tier limit for large models (50MB), but now have a limit of 1000 API calls per day.

Why it matters to this system:
- Ensuring agents can still access LLM services without exceeding daily API call limits.
- Updating agent configurations to use the most suitable providers based on the new limits and restrictions.
- Monitoring agent usage to detect potential API call overages and adjust accordingly.

One thing worth verifying:
- Test agent interactions with different LLM providers to ensure they can complete tasks without hitting daily API call limits.
